# Vendor / third-party packages

| Package | Path | Notes |
|---------|------|-------|
| slanCM | `vendor/slanCM/` | Colormap library |
| imshow3D | `vendor/imshow3D/` | 3D slice viewer (was oddly nested under Dong_func) |
| mat2im | `vendor/mat2im/` | Matrix→RGB helper (was under utils/) |

`init_sbd` addpaths `vendor/` via `genpath`. Project domain code lives in `lib/`, not here.
